result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: it adds Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP claims, Vendor legal violations, Vendor-caused Customer Data breaches, and gross negligence or wilful misconduct; covers Customer and its Affiliates; includes standard claim procedures; and narrows Customer's indemnity to Customer-provided materials and legal violations. The IP exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies are consistent with the fallback and with Section 9.3's existing cross-reference. No 3× cap is necessary because the broader, uncapped preferred position was achieved. The revisions preserve the unrelated termination language and are professionally drafted, with only minor potential ambiguity regarding the scope of the refund in Section 20.5.
